# FileZenith — 100% Client-Side PDF, Image & Utility Web Studio

> FileZenith (https://www.filezenith.com) is a 100% free, zero-server-upload, privacy-guaranteed online file processing platform. All PDF editing, compression, image conversions, and document operations run locally inside the user's web browser using WebAssembly and client-side JavaScript. Files are never uploaded, stored, or transmitted to external servers.

## Key Capabilities & Security Guarantees
- **100% Free & Unlimited**: Zero subscriptions, no credit card, no daily file conversion caps.
- **Zero Server Uploads**: 100% client-side computation in browser memory for GDPR & HIPAA compliance.
- **No Account Required**: Immediate instant processing with zero login or registration.
- **PWA Offline Support**: Operates 100% offline as a Progressive Web App.

## PDF Studio Tools
- [Edit PDF Online](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/edit): Free interactive PDF editor to add text, whiteout content, draw, and sign PDF documents.
- [Compress PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/compress): Reduce PDF file size 100% privately without quality loss.
- [Compress PDF to 200KB](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/compress-to-200kb): Target 200KB compression preset for job application and government web portals.
- [Merge PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/merge): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file.
- [Split PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/split): Visual PDF page extractor with high-DPI page previews.
- [Organize & Rotate PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/organize): Rotate, reorder, or delete individual PDF pages.
- [PDF OCR Text Extractor](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/ocr): Extract selectable text from scanned PDF documents locally using Tesseract.js.
- [Watermark PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/watermark): Add custom text or image watermarks to PDF pages.
- [Password Protect PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/protect): Encrypt PDF files with 128-bit AES password security.
- [PDF to JPG / PNG](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/to-image): Convert PDF pages to crisp high-resolution images.

## Image Studio Tools
- [Pics to PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/image/pics-to-pdf): Convert photos, scans, and receipts into structured PDF documents.
- [PNG to JPG Converter](https://www.filezenith.com/image/png-to-jpg): Convert PNG images to JPG with custom quality controls.
- [PNG to PDF Converter](https://www.filezenith.com/image/png-to-pdf): Save PNG pictures directly as PDF files.
- [JPG to PNG Converter](https://www.filezenith.com/image/jpg-to-png): Convert JPG images to PNG with transparency support.
- [Compress Image (Target KB)](https://www.filezenith.com/image/compress): Target KB image compressor for 50KB, 100KB, and custom limits.
- [Compress Image to 50KB](https://www.filezenith.com/image/compress-to-50kb): Shrink photos under 50KB for online forms.
- [Compress Image to 100KB](https://www.filezenith.com/image/compress-to-100kb): Shrink photos under 100KB for application portals.
- [Resize Image](https://www.filezenith.com/image/resize): Resize images by exact pixels or percentage ratio.
- [Passport Photo Maker](https://www.filezenith.com/image/passport-maker): Crop photos to official 2x2 inch and 35x45mm passport/visa dimensions.
- [AI Background Remover](https://www.filezenith.com/image/remove-background): Remove image backgrounds 100% in browser.
- [Apple HEIC to JPG Converter](https://www.filezenith.com/image/convert-heic): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG format.
- [Image to PDF Converter](https://www.filezenith.com/image/to-pdf): Convert WEBP, BMP, and GIF images to PDF.

## Daily Quick Utilities
- [Vector QR Code Generator](https://www.filezenith.com/utility/qr-generator): Generate SVG and PNG QR codes with logos and colors.
- [Word Counter & Keyword Analyzer](https://www.filezenith.com/utility/word-counter): Count words, characters, reading speed, and keyword density.
- [JSON Formatter & CSV Converter](https://www.filezenith.com/utility/json-formatter): Format, validate, and convert JSON to CSV and YAML.
